response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) rather than C++. His only substantive C++ experience was a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the 8-12 years of C++/STL, multi-threading, and systems-level expertise this role demands. There is no evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, message-broker architectures, or industrial protocol experience required for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery skills
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks) applicable to secure engineering practices
concerns: Minimal hands-on C++ experience (only a few months, over a decade ago) versus the deep, current C++/STL expertise required
No demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, SDL, industrial protocols, MQTT, or message-broker architectures central to this role
Career trajectory and recent roles (2018-present) are focused on web/full-stack and cloud-native JS/TS work, not industrial or embedded systems

key_factors.factor: No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) or IoT protocol experience
Strong general engineering seniority and adaptability
